newsitem.title: USA: ABN AMRO names Wigglesworth as unit head.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO names Wigglesworth as unit head.

text.p: ABN AMRO Chicago Corp (UK) Ltd said Friday it named Jack Wigglesworth to the newly created position of chairman.
He is chairman of the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange,
Robert MacArthur, managing director of ABN AMRO Chicago Corp (UK) Ltd in London, said Wigglesworth will be active in the planned development of the company's global futures business.
ABN AMRO Chicago Corp was created January 2, 1997 with the acquisition of ChiCorp Inc, parent of Chicago Corporation, by ABN AMRO Holding North America Inc, a subsidiary of ABN AMRO NV.
ABN AMRO Chicago Corp provides execution and clearing services with access to the world's financial exchanges.
